projects.name: LLM Resume Matcher
projects.description: An automated resume screening tool that extracts structured requirements from a job description and evaluates multiple candidate resumes (PDF/DOCX) to compute a match score and candidate ranking.
features: Structured extraction from job descriptions (roles, skills, experience, responsibilities)
Text extraction from PDF and DOCX resumes
Resume parsing into strongly typed JSON structures (education, skills, projects, certifications)
Multi-factor evaluation (technical skills, project relevance, experience match)
Batch processing and ranking of multiple resumes from a directory

projects.name: AI Portfolio Assistant
projects.description: An interactive portfolio web app featuring a real-time streaming AI chatbot that accurately answers visitor and recruiter questions about Aryan.
features: Real-time token streaming using chunked HTTP transfer
Sliding-window context memory to keep multi-turn conversation coherent without context explosion
Strict grounding to avoid hallucinations about unverified skills or private details
